experiments.scope: Exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 complete 256-bit hash of 64-byte single-block messages (CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT, block_len 64, counter 0), computed only by the submitted 8-way SWAR packed evaluator (eight messages per 256-bit word as eight disjoint 32-bit lanes; per-field carry-isolated addition, masked 32-bit rotation, field-wise XOR; lane j's digest unpacked from o0..o7 = v[i]^v[i+8]). Per organizer seed: N_t = 1024 = 2^10 independent uniform messages, 20-bit digest-XOR mask spread over all eight output words. All 1024 samples are evaluated and all 256 trials are returned, including failures.
experiments.hypothesis: (1) Every returned pair is a genuine masked match of the trusted blake3-r2 digest, so the SWAR packed evaluator computes the exact 256-bit digest. (2) The success frequency of this scaled analogue (N_t^2/2^w = 1 = N^2/2^256) is consistent with the independent-uniform value 1 - prod_{i<1024}(1 - i/2^20) = 0.39327 that heuristic H1 assumes for the table events at full width. Finite frequencies are supporting evidence, not a certified population probability.

experiments.scope: Same evaluator and target; per organizer seed N_t = 1024 independent uniform 64-byte messages, under a different 20-bit mask concentrated in the low 64 digest bits (output words o6,o7). All 256 trials are returned, including failures.
experiments.hypothesis: A 20-bit masked event concentrated in two output words shows no masked-collision excess or deficit relative to the independent-uniform value 0.39327; concentrating the mask does not change the birthday behaviour heuristic H1 assumes for the table events.
